title: A licensee's duty to maintain patient confidentiality and protect a patient's confidential information
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(16), a licensee shall maintain patient confidentiality and protect a patient's confidential information. The paragraph lists no permitted disclosures or recipients, states no exception, and defines none of its terms, including patient confidentiality and confidential information.
exam_relevance: Tests the two duties in 247 CMR 9.01(16), to maintain patient confidentiality and to protect a patient's confidential information, and what the paragraph leaves unstated.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The paragraph states two duties: to maintain patient confidentiality and to protect a patient's confidential information.
The paragraph itself lists no disclosure as permitted.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
